core_obligations: The functor on presheaves (proof lines 10624-10630): the pushforward is the direct image, and since all the colimits defining the left Kan extension are filtered under the hypotheses, the same colimits define a functor on presheaves of algebraic structures.
The adjunction (proof lines 10631-10632): adjointness is established by the same argument as for the corresponding lemma on presheaves of sets.

The pullback on sheaves (proof lines 10633-10635): the discussion of sheafification of presheaves of algebraic structures gives the definition of the pullback as the sheafification of the left Kan extension, which also shows that the functors commute with the underlying sheaves of sets.
proof_roadmap: Define the left Kan extension on presheaves of algebraic structures using the same filtered colimits.
Define the pullback on sheaves by sheafification and record the compatibility with underlying sets.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that under the hypotheses of the companion proposition the pullback and pushforward extend to an adjoint pair on sheaves and presheaves of algebraic structures, compatibly with the underlying sheaves of sets (statement lines 10610-10621). The proof is a complete argument: the filteredness of the colimits defining the left Kan extension lets those colimits define a functor on presheaves of algebraic structures (proof lines 10624-10630); adjointness is obtained by the same argument as for the corresponding statement on presheaves of sets (proof lines 10631-10632); and the pullback on sheaves is defined by sheafification, which also gives the compatibility with underlying sets (proof lines 10633-10635). The non-formal content is the reduction of the definitions to the set-based case. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
